description: This file contains the implementation of a membership table for Orleans using Apache ZooKeeper for cluster coordination and state management. It provides methods to initialize the membership table, read individual or all entries, insert/update/delete silo membership entries, and update specific fields like IAmAlive. The class manages interactions with ZooKeeper nodes, handles transactions atomically, and uses watchers for event handling.

classes.name: ZooKeeperBasedMembershipTable
classes.description: Implements Orleans IMembershipTable interface using ZooKeeper for distributed cluster membership management.

classes.name: ZooKeeperWatcher
classes.description: A watcher class for ZooKeeper events, mainly for debugging and event logging.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the ZooKeeper nodes for cluster deployment and silos, creating the cluster path if necessary.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads membership info for a specific silo, returning data atomically.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads the entire membership table atomically, retrieving all silos.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Atomically inserts a new membership entry for a silo and updates the table version.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Atomically updates a silo's membership info and the table version.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates only the IAmAlive timestamp of a silo in an unconditional, 'dirty' manner.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Removes all entries for a specified clusterId.
